comparison: byte-level binary64 comparison of complete trajectories, per-RHS-stage traces, native atmospheric inputs and output-sample diagnostics against single-threaded propagate(); no tolerance is applied anywhere
spice_provider_lifetime: one Environment constructed before any batch and destroyed after the last one; every per-trajectory DirectAtmosphere borrows it by reference

spice_reuse_statistics.note: counters are populated only in LEO_SPICE_REUSE_DIAGNOSTICS builds

validation_settings.perturbation_generator: splitmix64, uniform in [-sigma, sigma], stream seeded with seed + 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15 * (trajectory index + 1)

summary.final_state_format: trajectory elapsed_s, then r.x r.y r.z v.x v.y v.z q.w q.x q.y q.z omega.x omega.y omega.z at the last requested output
